reason: I like the idea of a ranked morning list instead of me chasing acknowledgements in Outlook, but I can't hand ERP and supplier email data to a pre-MVP startup without IT and security signing off, and I'm not going to pay $2,000 a month for a month-to-month tool from a company that may not be around next year.
objection: A pre-MVP startup might not be around next year, and I'd be giving it our open POs and supplier email before my security team has even looked at it.
would_change_my_mind: A security review my IT team can actually sign off on, plus proof from the free six-week test on our own exports that it catches real short ships and missing acknowledgements before they hit work orders.
